name: AppInstaller
intent: Marketplace / app-installer scaffold: a full app shell (CoreAppSidebar + CoreAppTopBar) with a single "Home" sidebar entry plus the shared "App Store" plus below it. Home is the landing surface — a welcome hero greeting the user with a Browse App Store CTA while nothing is installed, and an app launcher grid once apps exist. The App Store surface is a PageContentHeader with two tabs (App Store / Installed Apps), a scrollable category pill filter, search with match highlighting, and a responsive grid of app cards (icon, category, blurb, Installed badge) each carrying a Details dialog and an Install / Uninstall action.
when: Building the marketplace / app-installer surface where users browse and install Core apps
A catalog surface that owns its own app shell and organizes content by a peer tab set in the header
whenNot: A content page rendered inside an existing app shell -> use a content-only template
A multi-section admin surface where the left nav switches content -> use Admin Panel
An app that ships several sidebar entries of its own -> use Workforce / Safety Manager as the base

chooseOver.component: Assembling CoreAppSidebar + CoreAppTopBar + PageContentHeader by hand
chooseOver.because: App Installer owns the shell and the marketplace catalog so a store surface plugs straight in.

allowedPlacement: route-level marketplace / app-installer surface that owns the full window

extracted: description-less route header scaffold with tabs
the shared Marketplace plus entry added to CoreAppSidebar

lineage.confidence: unset — scaffold, no held-out eval yet
notes: App catalog is sample data; install/update/uninstall is local state only
Lands on Home: welcome hero while nothing is installed, app launcher once apps exist
